decisive_items: a diagnosis of hemangiopericytoma was entertained
Contrast-enhanced MRI demonstrated a 6.2×7.1×7.0 cm extra-axial ovoid mass
response.rationale: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings, including the location and characteristics of the mass, are consistent with a diagnosis of hemangiopericytoma, a rare type of tumor.

rejected.why: The erosion of the bone, while suggestive of an aggressive bone tumor, is not specific enough to rule out other diagnoses.
